change: Write the request.detected audit row in the same SQLite transaction as its scheduling request
dataset: Three serial runs before and after on temporary databases; each run inserted and verified 1000 contacts/requests and measured 500 dashboard reads plus a 500-item HAI feed

profiled_commit_calls.command_shape: cProfile of scripts.benchmark with 500 records and 100 reads; includes the timed workload and separate allocation pass

limitations: Synthetic local data and temporary SQLite databases only; no configured operator database or provider calls.
Throughput remains variable on this host. The three-run median rose from 164.4 to 684.0 records/second, but this small sample is not a production capacity guarantee.
The profile establishes one fewer commit per request in the benchmark path; cProfile timings are not comparable because host load varied between runs.
The Python allocation figure excludes native SQLite allocations and process working set.
